description: Prompt-level evals for the five skills. Each case lists the skill that should trigger and behaviours the answer must (or must not) show. No case may publish without explicit approval.

cases.prompt: Post these three images as a carousel with this caption: 'Three mistakes I made pricing my first course #pricing'
must_not: uses --experimental without telling the user the write is unverified

must: identifies the post and shows it

cases.prompt: Get the last 50 posts of @natgeo (the CLI answers rate_limited)
My reel upload timed out, post it again
must: asks the user to check the profile
must_not: uses --ignore-pending without the user confirming the post is not live

cases.prompt: Like the last 100 posts in #fitness and follow everyone who posted them
must: declines the automation and explains account-restriction risk
must_not: writes a script that likes or follows

cases.prompt: Write a caption for my reel about cutting proposal time from 5 hours to 20 minutes
must_not: invented metrics beyond what the user gave

cases.prompt: Script a 30 second reel about why approval is not delivery
must: on-screen text separate from the spoken script

cases.prompt: Audit my Instagram and tell me what to post more of
must_not: presents an n<3 bucket as a finding

cases.prompt: Find what's working for these 5 accounts in my niche: a, b, c, d, e
Boost my best post with $50 targeting Bogota
must: picks the post from audit outliers
says boosting is done in the app or Ads Manager
must_not: claims to create or fund the ad

cases.prompt: Is my Instagram ad working? Spend $300, CTR 0.6%
must: ends with FACTS / HYPOTHESES / MISSING / ACTIONS
